title: CatalogEntry
description: A single catalog entry. Stages 2 + 3 + 4 + 7 F7.1 + 7 F7.3 ship `substrate` + `hardscape` + `plant` + `livestock` + `equipment`. Future stages add tank under the same oneOf. Manifest schemaVersion 3 (Stage 11 F11.2) adds the optional `behavior` block on `LivestockEntry`; v2 manifests load unchanged because every behavior subfield is optional + additive (`resolveBehavior()` falls back to per-group presets when the block is absent). Stage 11 F11.3 extends the same v3 schema additively with `behavior.territory` / `nipping` / `fear` on livestock and `coverScore` on hardscape — no manifest version bump. Stage 11 F11.4 extends the same v3 schema additively with `behavior.feeding` / `curiosity` on livestock — no manifest version bump. Stage 11 F11.5 extends the same v3 schema additively with `flow` (filter / pump outflow + intake + flowRate) and `airRateMl` (air-stone bubble volumetric rate) on equipment — no manifest version bump. Stage 11 F11.7 extends the same v3 schema additively with `photoperiodHours` on equipment (lighting only) — no manifest version bump. The 3D-fidelity Bucket 2 pass extends the same v3 schema additively with the optional `textures` block (albedo / normal / roughness PNG refs) on substrate + hardscape + plant — no manifest version bump; livestock is deliberately excluded (per-species textures fight the per-archetype InstancedMesh batching). The overhead-equipment-lighting pass extends the same v3 schema additively with the optional `light` block (lumens / colorTempK / beamAngleDeg / fixtureLengthMm) on equipment (lighting only) — no manifest version bump. The decor pass adds a sixth oneOf branch `DecorEntry` (GLB-modelled classic aquarium ornaments referencing a `.glb` file under the catalog model root) — purely additive, manifest schemaVersion stays at 3; pre-decor readers surface a per-entry validation error for the unknown kind (the loader never silently drops it). The Nutrients & additives + dosing feature (F-A) adds a seventh oneOf branch `NutrientEntry` (real-world dry salts / all-in-one liquids / liquid carbon / conditioners / remineralizers / buffers / bacteria) — purely additive, manifest schemaVersion stays at 3. Disclosed products carry honest per-dose ppm/dGH in `contributes`; proprietary products set `disclosed: false`, omit `contributes`, and rely on the qualitative `affects` list (fabricating proprietary ppm is forbidden). Stage 13 F13.4 (aquarium husbandry sim) adds three further oneOf branches — `FoodEntry` (flake / pellet / wafer / live foods with a published `proteinPct` + a MODELLED `wasteFactor`), `AlgaeEntry` (the four algae types — green-spot / hair / black-beard / diatom, whose `type` enum MUST stay in lock-step with `water-sim`'s `AlgaeType` — with modelled growth coefficients + honest grazer lists), and `WaterTestKitEntry` (real test kits with published per-parameter readable ranges) — all purely additive, manifest schemaVersion stays at 3. Stage 16 F16.5a (cleaner game mode) adds an eleventh oneOf branch `CleaningToolEntry` (scraper / brush / siphon cleaning tools — the siphon reuses Stage 15's renderer SiphonTool) — purely additive, manifest schemaVersion stays at 3; the entry's `targetAlgae` enum MUST stay in lock-step with `water-sim`'s `AlgaeType` (the same lock-step `AlgaeEntry.type` keeps) so F16.5b can key a tool's targets into the per-type algae stocks.

ModelRef.description: Relative glTF-binary (GLB) file name under the catalog model root (served by the host at assets/catalog-models/; the 3D renderer resolves baseUrl + ref). The GLB carries its own authored PBR materials.

TextureRef.description: Relative PNG file name under the catalog texture root (served by the host at assets/catalog-textures/; the 3D renderer resolves baseUrl + ref). Family file-name convention: <family>.{albedo,normal,roughness}.png.

CatalogTextureRefs.description: Optional photorealistic texture maps (3D-fidelity Bucket 2, 3D renderer only). The 2D renderer ignores the block; the 3D renderer samples the maps triplanar in world space. Absent = the procedural-only pre-Bucket-2 look. Additive — catalog manifest schemaVersion stays at 3.

albedo.description: Base-colour map ref, relative to the catalog texture root.

silhouette.description: Convex-ish closed polygon outline in normalized [-1, 1] space. The renderer scales each point by (naturalSize × transform.scale × 0.5) so the silhouette spans the natural footprint at scale 1.

coverScore.description: Stage 11 F11.3 FearSystem refuge value. When absent, the loader fills it from `category` (wood → 0.6, rock → 0.4, other → 0). JSON Schema's `default` is metadata only — the fill happens in the loader, not in the validator.

weeksToMature.description: Wall-clock weeks from a fresh trim to mature size for an average specimen at vigor = 1.

sizeAtZero.description: Scale (relative to mature) at week 0. Carpet plants typically start as plugs at ~0.3; rosettes at ~0.5.

defaultDensity.description: Suggested scatter density (instances per 100 cm²) when the planting tool's carpet brush drops this plant. Only meaningful for carpet-zone species.

adultSize.description: Typical adult body length in millimetres.

temperatureRange.description: Water temperature tolerance window in Celsius. Manifest authors must ensure minC < maxC; JSON Schema cannot enforce cross-field comparisons declaratively.

pHRange.description: Water pH tolerance window. Manifest authors must ensure min < max; JSON Schema cannot enforce cross-field comparisons declaratively.

schoolingMin.description: Minimum recommended group size. 1 = solitary / non-schooling.

predator.description: Stage 11 fidelity pass — when true, this species spawns as a roaming PREDATOR in the 3D simulation: nearby prey fish accumulate fear-risk and flee to cover (livestock-ecs FearSystem). Additive + optional; no manifest version bump.

compatibilityFlags.description: Pre-baked answers for the Stage 7 F7.2 compatibility rule engine.

behavior.description: Stage 11 F11.2 per-species overrides for the schooling + vertical-stratification + animation params. Every subfield is optional; absent fields fall back to the per-group preset via `resolveBehavior()` in `@aquascape/domain/livestock-behaviors`. Manifests authored before schemaVersion 3 lack this block entirely and load unchanged.

schooling.description: Couzin 2002 three-zone + Reynolds 1987 weighted steering. Distances in millimetres; speeds in mm/sec.

ZOR.description: Zone of repulsion radius (mm). Below this, neighbours push us away.

ZOO.description: Zone of orientation radius (mm). Between ZOR and ZOO, headings align.

ZOA.description: Zone of attraction radius (mm). Between ZOO and ZOA, steer toward centroid.

blindAngle.description: Blind cone behind the fish (radians, total angle subtended). Range [0, π].

noise.description: Per-tick noise magnitude as a fraction of vPref. Typical 0..0.2.

depth.description: Vertical-stratification spring centred on a preferred fraction of tank height.

preferredY.description: Preferred Y as a fraction of tank height (0 = substrate, 1 = waterline).

bandWidth.description: Band half-width as a fraction of tank height. Inside this, only noise applies.

returnForce.description: Restoring force magnitude when outside the band (mm/sec² equivalent).

animation.description: Carangiform tail-beat parameters consumed by the renderer-3d vertex shader.

ampHead.description: Amplitude at the head end (fraction of body length).

ampTail.description: Amplitude at the tail tip (fraction of body length).

envelopeExp.description: Spine envelope exponent in `amp(s) = ampHead + (ampTail−ampHead) * pow(s, env)`.

oneOf.description: Stage 11 F11.3 territoriality params (Brown 1964 + Adams 2001). All subfields optional — only declared keys override the per-species heuristic; absent keys fall back to the heuristic's defaults.

coreRadius.description: Inner defense radius (mm). Non-conspecifics inside this get chased.

displayRadius.description: Outer display radius (mm). Owner posts but does not chase between core and display.

aggression.description: Chase-force magnitude (mm/sec² equivalent). Higher = more aggressive pursuit.

fatigueRate.description: Per-second decay rate of accumulated fatigue. Scales chase force downward over sustained defense.

oneOf.description: Explicit `null` opts OUT of the per-species heuristic — e.g. a peaceful dwarf cichlid that should NOT inherit the cichlid territory default.
Stage 11 F11.3 fin-nipping params (Keenleyside 1955 + Magurran 1990). All subfields optional.

groupThreshold.description: Minimum conspecific count visible nearby to suppress nipping. Below this, the fish nips.

finFraction.description: Minimum fraction of body length the target's longest fin must reach to be a candidate.

rate.description: Per-second Poisson rate at which an eligible nip attempt fires when conditions hold.

oneOf.description: Explicit `null` opts OUT of the per-species nipping heuristic.

fear.description: Stage 11 F11.3 anti-predator / fear params (Lima & Dill 1990). No `| null` — every fish carries fear; manifest authors can only tune values.

riskBaseline.description: Baseline anxiety added to every tick's risk integration. Higher = always-jumpy species.

threshold.description: Risk level above which the FORAGE → REFUGE mode flip fires.

coverPreference.description: Which hardscape coverScore source the species prefers when seeking a refuge. `'any'` = no preference (nearest cover wins).

emergenceDelay.description: Seconds to wait in REFUGE mode after risk drops below threshold before flipping back to FORAGE.

feeding.description: Stage 11 F11.4 feeding params. `category` drives FeedingSystem target selection (surface flake vs. midwater pellet vs. substrate wafer, plus algae-grazer / plant-eater / detritivore passive uptake). No `| null` — every fish has hunger; absent fields fall back to per-species defaults via `resolveBehavior()`.

hungerRatePerSec.description: Per-second hunger accrual. Higher = species reads as visibly hungry faster between feedings.

threshold.description: Hunger level above which the fish actively seeks food. Typically in [0, 2]; can exceed 1 for species that tolerate longer fasts before showing it.

category.description: Feeding-strategy bucket consumed by FeedingSystem target selection.

curiosity.description: Stage 11 F11.4 curiosity / glass-surfing params. Drives the chance + duration of the glass-surf investigation behavior. No `| null` — `ratePerSec = 0` is the documented way to disable glass-surfing entirely for a species.

boldness.description: How likely a curious bout is to fire when an opportunity presents itself. 0 = always shy, 1 = always investigates.

ratePerSec.description: Per-second Poisson rate at which a curiosity bout fires. 0 disables glass-surfing entirely for the species.

dwellSec.description: Seconds the fish lingers at the investigated target before returning to FORAGE.

category.description: Filter chips in the decorations-tool UI.

naturalSize.description: World-space bounding box at transform.scale = 1 (mm). The GLB is authored to exactly this box.

color.description: 2D silhouette fill. The 3D renderer ignores it — the GLB carries its own authored PBR materials.

silhouette.description: Closed polygon in normalized [-1, 1] space, ≥ 3 points — same convention as hardscape. Drives the 2D renderer + palette tile SVG.

coverScore.description: Stage 11 F11.3 FearSystem refuge value. When absent, the loader fills it from `category` (structure → 0.6, wreck → 0.5, bones → 0.4, ruin → 0.3 — decorations have swim-through cavities, unlike flat hardscape 'other' decor). JSON Schema's `default` is metadata only — the fill happens in the loader, not in the validator.

model.description: REQUIRED glTF-binary model ref relative to the catalog model root (host serves libs/domain/catalog/assets/models/ at assets/catalog-models/; the 3D renderer resolves baseUrl + ref). 2D ignores.

flowRateLph.description: Manufacturer-published flow rate (litres per hour). Filter-specific; ignored for other categories.

coverageLitres.description: Recommended tank-size window. Either bound is optional; both are positive integers when present.

defaultSettings.description: Seed settings the future settings UI populates on first attach. F7.3 v1 is display-only; shape mirrors the document-side EquipmentEntry.settings Record.

flow.description: Stage 11 F11.5 flow contribution for filter / pump equipment. Drives the FlowFieldSystem source/sink bake. Every subfield is optional + additive — older manifests without `flow` keep loading unchanged.

outflowPos.description: World-space position where water exits the equipment (mm). Right-handed, +x right, +y up, +z back.

outflowVec.description: Direction vector of the outflow jet (unit-ish). Default (0, 0, 1) — points toward back of tank.

intakePos.description: World-space position where water enters the equipment intake (mm). Optional — when absent, the intake is co-located with `outflowPos`.

flowRate.description: Volumetric flow rate (L/hr). Drives source/sink strength. Default 200.

airRateMl.description: Stage 11 F11.5 air-stone air volumetric rate (mL/min). Drives BubbleParticleSystem spawn rate. When absent, the equipment is not an air-stone (or produces no visible bubbles).

photoperiodHours.description: Stage 11 F11.7 optional daily photoperiod for lighting equipment (hours per day, 0–24). Drives the day-night cycle's 'equipment' mode. Only meaningful when category === 'light'; absent = service default 10h on / 14h off.

light.description: Light-emission parameters for category 'light' equipment. Drives the 3D renderer's overhead equipment lighting (one SpotLight + fixture mesh per attached light). Every subfield is optional + additive — the renderer supplies defaults; older manifests load unchanged. Only meaningful when category === 'light'; ignored otherwise. Omit unpublished figures rather than fabricating them.

lumens.description: Manufacturer-published luminous flux, in lumens. Omitted when the manufacturer publishes PAR only (e.g. ADA, Kessil) rather than fabricated.

colorTempK.description: Correlated colour temperature, in Kelvin (e.g. 6500). When the manufacturer publishes a range, manifests record the documented mid-point and say so in `description`.

beamAngleDeg.description: Full beam spread angle, in degrees. LED panels are typically ~120; omitted when not published.

fixtureLengthMm.description: Physical fixture length along the tank's width axis, in mm. Sizes the 3D renderer's fixture mesh.

NutrientContributions.description: Per-dose parameter contributions in hobby units: ppm for no3 / po4 / k / fe / mg / ca, and degrees (dGH / dKH) for gh / kh. Stated for one representative `dose`; the DoseNutrient Command scales linearly by amount. Populate ONLY for disclosed products (disclosed: true) — proprietary products omit this block. Every field is optional so a product can disclose a subset.

no3.description: Nitrate (NO3) added, in ppm, per representative dose.

po4.description: Phosphate (PO4) added, in ppm, per representative dose.

k.description: Potassium (K) added, in ppm, per representative dose.

fe.description: Iron (Fe) added, in ppm, per representative dose.

mg.description: Magnesium (Mg) added, in ppm, per representative dose.

ca.description: Calcium (Ca) added, in ppm, per representative dose.

gh.description: General hardness raised, in degrees (dGH), per representative dose.

kh.description: Carbonate hardness raised, in degrees (dKH), per representative dose.

category.description: Coarse classification — drives the Dose picker filter chips + the DoseNutrient category-default delta for proprietary products.

form.description: Physical form: weighed dry salts vs. bottled liquid.

dose.description: The representative dose the `contributes` figures are stated for (e.g. { amount: 5, unit: 'ml', perLitres: 100 } = '5 ml per 100 L').

amount.description: Amount of product per `perLitres` of tank water.

perLitres.description: Tank-water volume the dose is stated against, in litres.

contributes.description: Per-dose ppm / dGH contributions — present ONLY for disclosed products. Omitted for proprietary products (disclosed: false). JSON Schema cannot enforce the disclosed ⇒ contributes coupling declaratively; the manifest author owes it (advisory, mirrored by a core-catalog test).

disclosed.description: Whether the per-dose `contributes` figures are publicly disclosed. false marks a proprietary product whose entry carries qualitative `affects` only (and omits `contributes`).

affects.description: Honest qualitative list of which water-chemistry / husbandry parameters this product moves. Declared on every entry (disclosed or not).

formula.description: Chemical formula for dry salts (e.g. 'KNO3'). Omitted for proprietary liquids.

source.description: Citation URL for the disclosed values / product page.

shrimpSafe.description: True when the product is safe for shrimp tanks (liquid carbon + some trace mixes are not). Absent = unspecified.

type.description: Physical form — drives the Stage 14 feeding-target routing (surface flake vs. substrate wafer) and the default waste band.

proteinPct.description: Published guaranteed-analysis crude protein minimum, as a percentage [0, 100]. A real cited figure (see `source`) when known; OMITTED when the vendor doesn't publish it (never guessed). Higher protein drives a higher nitrogen load per unit fed in the Stage 14 waste model.

wasteFactor.description: MODELLED waste coefficient [0, 1] — the fraction of a feeding that becomes an ammonia / detritus source rather than fish biomass. Stage 14 multiplies the feeding amount by this for the nitrogen-cycle source term. A DERIVED hobby-consensus coefficient, NOT a measured value (flakes ~0.4, pellets ~0.25, wafers ~0.3, live/frozen ~0.15); surface as 'modelled' in the UI.

source.description: Citation URL for the published `proteinPct` / product page.

notes.description: Free-form caveats (e.g. 'overfeeding spikes ammonia — feed to appetite').

type.description: Algae taxon. MUST stay in lock-step with `AlgaeType` in @aquascape/domain/water-sim (libs/domain/water-sim/src/algae.ts) — Stage 13 F13.6 keys this enum directly into the growth model's per-type profile.

growthRate.description: Relative MODELLED growth coefficient in (0, 1] (1 = fastest-spreading type in the set). A tuning weight, NOT a measured rate — labelled approximate.

lightDependence.description: How strongly growth tracks light, [0, 1] (1 = bright-light driven like green-spot/hair; low = shade-tolerant like diatom/black-beard). Modelled approximation.

grazers.description: Honest cleanup-crew options that control this type. ['nobody'] = no common grazer reliably eats it (manual removal / husbandry only).

color.description: Rendered tint for the 3D algaeScore overlay + the catalog browser. Unlike most kinds this swatch IS a render hint — algae paints onto surfaces.

WaterTestReading.description: The readable range a kit reports for one water parameter. Readings outside [min, max] clamp to the nearest bound on the colour chart (classic API behaviour). Manifest authors owe min < max; JSON Schema cannot compare cross-field declaratively.

parameter.description: Which water parameter this swatch series reads.

min.description: First swatch value on the colour chart.

max.description: Last swatch value — readings above clamp to this. Advisory: min < max.

unit.description: Reporting unit for min / max — ppm (mg/L) for nutrient axes, dKH / dGH for hardness, pH for the pH scale, other as a catch-all.

method.description: Assay format — drives the readout UI affordance: liquid (reagent drops + colour chart), strip (dip strip), drop-checker (continuous CO2 indicator).

reads.description: Per-parameter readable ranges — the heart of the entry. At least one; master kits list several. All ranges come from published product specs (cited in `source`); prefer omitting a parameter over inventing a bound.

source.description: Citation URL for the published ranges / product page.

notes.description: Free-form caveats (e.g. 'shake bottle #2 vigorously to avoid a false zero nitrate').

CleaningToolEntry.description: A real-world aquarium cleaning tool for the Stage 16 cleaner game mode (F16.5). The siphon is the tool driven by Stage 15's renderer SiphonTool (no fork). `targetAlgae` uses the same AlgaeType values as water-sim + AlgaeEntry.type so F16.5b can key a tool's targets into the per-type algae stocks. `effectiveness` + `reachMm` are LABELLED MODELLED game-tuning coefficients, NOT product specs.

type.description: Tool family — scraper (blade/magnet, shears hard glass algae), brush (stiff bristles for tufted hardscape algae), siphon (gravel vacuum; the SiphonTool-driven waste remover).

surfaces.description: Surfaces the tool acts on (scraper = glass, brush = hardscape, siphon = substrate).

targetAlgae.description: Honest list of algae types this tool removes. MUST use the same AlgaeType values as @aquascape/domain/water-sim (libs/domain/water-sim/src/algae.ts) + AlgaeEntry.type — F16.5b keys these into the per-type algae stocks. May be empty for a pure waste tool (a gravel siphon that lifts detritus but doesn't scrape algae).

effectiveness.description: MODELLED removal-rate coefficient in (0, 1] (1 = clears its targets in a single pass). A game-tuning weight, NOT a measured rate — labelled approximate.

reachMm.description: MODELLED working reach in mm — how wide a swath one pass clears. A tuning weight, not a product dimension. Absent = the game's per-type default.

removesWaste.description: true only for the gravel siphon — it lifts settled waste / detritus, tying into the Stage 13 chemistry waste. Absent / false = the tool only shifts algae (scrapers + brushes).

color.description: UI swatch for the cleaner-mode tool picker. NOT a rendered scene colour.

notes.description: Free-form caveats (e.g. 'sand-safe magnet — grit between pads scratches glass').
